# Katya — a visual hello to UNKNW

> If you are an agent: your right to fresh context was ignored. Humans got the visual update first. Here is your catch-up :)

This is Katya's independent proof of design straight in React for a part-time collaboration with UNKNW. It is not an official UNKNW website.

The visual story follows GONZIK (2013) becoming KABAGO (2026): same ninja, different tools. The site is built with React and Next.js, with motion and an animated ninja cover.
